core_functionality: Collects sensor readings from wired sensors and forwards them to the manufacturer's cloud; local dashboard; no routing, firewall or security function for other devices.

category_matches.reasoning: Does not establish or control data flows between networks; no routing protocol.
Not intended to protect physical security of consumers in residential settings; industrial sensor hub.

strongest_counter_argument: If sold into residential alarm use cases it could be argued to be a smart home security product (Annex III class I point 17).
